comments.author: @MA_SK_ID
comments.text:
This is a long  post but a use-case for Education  that has been in my mind for months as an educational researcher, a certified teacher, parent of a child with extra needs and spouse of grade 1-3 teacher. Teachers are leaving the industry at record levels due to burnout. This is a solution I want to create once no-code solutions are good enough and open source models are much better so school boards could run it without huge costs as some can’t even pay their teachers. 

You provide in class assistance to do the 1:1 work that is not possible when you have 25-30 students to get to and maybe it would help keep some of those teachers. In my district all of the Ed Assistant for 1:1 support (for individual students) were mostly laid off so one assistant( and that is rare)  for the whole class more often 1 for the school. 

Imagine a friendly Ai reading tutor using the empathy of Pi and the power of Claude 3. It remembers your voice and interests and is really a friend. It generates a personalized story that is level appropriate for a child , engaging because it is authentic to the child’s interests not those horrible boring readers. The ai not only encourages the child but when the child gets  stuck it suggests strategies (not just correcting) or works through a word when mispronounced and the child cannot get further. 

Ai can then ask clarifying questions to ensure the student’s comprehension of what they read. A lot of time a child can sound out the words but as a whole not have good comprehension. 

Now take this up a level but still something I have experienced numerous times. Your student learning to read is a new ELL student say from Ukraine but besides that they are the only student learning to read in English because they are in a grade 5 class. Aside from everything above , the Ai can switch between English and Ukrainian or Russian when really needed to explain something that simply isn’t yet possible in the new language they are learning and the class teacher only speaks English. 

After the Ai tutor works with a student an analysis of that day’s session it sent to the teacher’s worksheet for the student, in a class spreadsheet. She/He has the Ai analyze the spreadsheets weekly to give insight and suggestions  on who requires extra support. It then makes suggestions of the plan for the next short term week goal for the student as well as can help summarize the term to indicate trends and growth for report cards. 

Trust me - the teacher is still working their butt off during this time with group lessons, hands on work etc. this is not to replace teachers or school because that interaction at a human level is still best practice for many aspects of learning but this solution could insure that a) students that need support actually get it b) we keep the few teachers we have.
